name: Western New Mexico University
why: Forestry/wildlife and fire focus next to the Gila; affordable in-state small town.

name: New Mexico State University-Main Campus
why: Wildlife and range sciences at home in Las Cruces; affordable land-grant.

name: Navajo Technical University
why: Tribal college with limited natural resources offerings; mission-specific.

name: Brigham Young University-Idaho
why: LDS-sponsored with honor code requirements; far; not a likely pick.

name: College of Southern Nevada
why: Urban community college; structural fire science, not wildland forestry.

name: Eastern New Mexico University-Main Campus
why: Wildlife and fisheries program, but plains setting, not mountains.

name: Westminster University
why: Environmental studies near mountains, but small private liberal arts, not field forestry.

name: Arizona State University Digital Immersion
why: Online ASU program; no field work or outdoor training.

name: Regis University
why: Environmental studies at urban Jesuit school; adjacent to forestry.

name: Brigham Young University
why: LDS-sponsored, selective; ecology research, not applied forestry or fire.

name: Northern New Mexico College
why: Small, cheap, near Santa Fe NF; environmental science adjacent to forestry.

name: Salish Kootenai College
why: Actual forestry degree in Montana mountains; tribal college and very far.

name: Colorado State University Pueblo
why: Natural resources adjacent field at mid-size Colorado public.

name: Aaniiih Nakoda College
why: Tiny tribal college; ecology only, mission-specific, very far.
